d.ko: A physics-based, realistic 3D sword-fighting game. Immerse yourself in a cinematic adventure, utilizing real sword-fighting martial arts and a variety of historically accurate weapons to survive brutal duels in 17th century Poland. Featuring single-player modes and a LOCAL 2-player mode.
d.en: A physics-based, realistic 3D sword-fighting game. Immerse yourself in a cinematic adventure, utilizing real sword-fighting martial arts and a variety of historically accurate weapons to survive brutal duels in 17th century Poland. Featuring single-player modes and a LOCAL 2-player mode.
d.zh: 《Hellish Quart》是一款基于物理的3D剑术格斗游戏，动作采用真实击剑的动作捕捉。体验真实碰撞的刀剑、电影般的决斗，以及设定在17世纪的单人故事战役。
